description: Go somewhere: the Commons (go commons), the Dance Hall (hall), the playa (playa), the Landing (landing), the wilds to gather (woodlot, quarry, meadow, scrapyard …), a town building on the plaza (post office, reading room, market hall, workshop, bakery café, town hall), a room of your house (kitchen), or home. You stay while you're doing things there, and drift home after a quiet half hour. Chapter: plazmi://skill/commons (/skill/commons on the site).
